analysis: Reviewed the changed ProviderLoop.swift state additions (lines 781-792 and 954 in the diff; units show the surrounding fields), the DaemonState coding key, decode and encode additions, and the DaemonStateFile.swift property and init additions. The change adds provider-local state: selectedModelRecovery, savedEnabledModels, enabledModelsAtLastSwitch, and a test-only load override. It also adds optional daemon-state fields: enabledModelsAtStart, enabledModelsAtLastSwitch and selectedModelRecovery. All new fields are decoded with decodeIfPresent and encoded with encodeIfPresent, so older readers, including the pre-update watchdog described in the DaemonState+Coding.swift comments, ignore unknown keys. The keys are additive and the schema stays at 1. The new fields hold model IDs and recovery status only. They carry no prompts, keys, tokens or attestation material, so A-001, A-003 and A-008 are not newly exposed. No new network, authorization or attestation surface appears in the supplied lines. The new fields do not touch the coordinator wire contract (TB-002), App Attest authorization (TB-011) or the add-on hold socket (TB-012). Unverified items, which are outside the supplied evidence: the SelectedModelRecovery logic in ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift, the writer of the daemon state file, the file's permissions, and the consumers in status and switch. The selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride seam is a test closure that is nil in production, and whether it is compiled out of production is not visible here. The recovery loader's memory-admission and eviction behavior, and whether it respects the drain, update and authorization gates, belongs to other files and was not reviewed. I found no concrete regression in these units.
